# proxmox_storage_volume_transfer (Resource)

Copies or moves a volume through `POST /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/content/{volume}` and waits for the worker. Every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_storage_volume_transfer" "copy" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  storage  = "local"
  volume   = "local:300/vm-300-disk-0.raw"
  target   = "local:300/vm-300-disk-0-copy.raw"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Source node.
- `storage` (String) Source storage.
- `target` (String) Target volume identifier.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to transfer again.
- `volume` (String) Source volume.

### Optional

- `target_node` (String) Target node when moving across nodes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in `<storage>/<volume>` form.
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
